garfield.name: Hungry Heist · Garfield
garfield.notes: Designed for Garfield: Hungry Heist (yru mal/garfield). Original voice, no actor imitation.

settings.speaker: Ryan
settings.ref_text: Diet biscuits. The saddest two words in any language. I'll get up in five minutes. Or fifty. Mmm, lasagna.

source_recipe.speaker: Ryan
source_recipe.instruct: A deep, mellow, laid-back American male voice, low and velvety with a lazy drawl. Bored, sarcastic, deadpan delivery, smug and cheeky but friendly, like a sleepy comedian muttering to himself.
source_recipe.text: Diet biscuits. The saddest two words in any language. I'll get up in five minutes. Or fifty. Mmm, lasagna.

jon.name: Hungry Heist · Jon (v2 male)
jon.notes: Garfield: Hungry Heist Jon v2 — adult male redesign (Aaron: v1 sounded like a girl). Original voice.

settings.speaker: Ryan
settings.ref_text: Here you go, buddy. Crunchy cat biscuits, your favourite. And for me, steak and mash! Oh boy, I've been looking forward to this all day.

source_recipe.speaker: Ryan
source_recipe.instruct: Adult male in his mid-thirties, deep-ish male baritone voice, low and warm. Friendly, cheerful, a little nerdy and awkward. Relaxed conversational American accent. Clearly a grown man.
source_recipe.text: Here you go, buddy. Crunchy cat biscuits, your favourite. And for me, steak and mash! Oh boy, I've been looking forward to this all day.

lyman.name: Hungry Heist · Lyman
lyman.notes: Garfield: Hungry Heist Lyman — theatrical dramatic moocher. Original voice, no actor imitation.

settings.speaker: Ryan
settings.ref_text: I'm cold. I'm hungry. I'm weak. Take me in! Ah, Jon, old buddy. You know, a man could get used to a sofa like this.

source_recipe.speaker: Ryan
source_recipe.instruct: Adult man in his thirties with a rich, theatrical, slightly hammy baritone voice. Dramatic and over-the-top like a struggling stage actor, a lovable moocher with smooth charm, rolling delivery, big sighs, grand gestures in the voice. American accent.
